items.title: Pete Candoli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: I remember him and that, and I say — because very few people even knew who Chick Webb was

ctx.x: Chick Webb. Isn’t that amazing? I remember him and that, and I say — because very few people even knew who Chick Webb was, let alone get on the record. It was usually hotel bands, and a few oddballs that were playing for listeners. And then it dawned upon me all the hotel bands had a pattern, a sound. It was like a product. They were smart. Like Sammy Kaye had [scats] before the singer got up, and Horace Hite [scats] all the triple tonguing. And everybody had a thing. Tommy Dorsey even played the first sixteen of…
I see. So that they had a signature that you would recognize.
